plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Cambium switch. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization, temperature, and interface traffic (enterprise PEN 2076).
name: Switch

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports chassis CPU utilization of the Cambium cnMatrix switch (issSwitchCurrentCPUThreshold) as a 0-100 percentage. Sustained high CPU usage can indicate control-plane overload, forwarding instability, or attack traffic.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports chassis memory used percent of the Cambium cnMatrix switch (issSwitchCurrentRAMUsage) as a 0-100 percentage. High memory usage may indicate leaks, oversized MAC/ARP tables, or insufficient capacity.

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: This metric reports chassis temperature of the Cambium cnMatrix switch (issSwitchCurrentTemperature) in degrees Celsius. Sustained high temperature can indicate cooling failure or an overheated environment.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
